user explicitly asks for a full, deep reading on a complex tangled situation — uses the 10-card Celtic Cross spread, revealed ONE CARD AT A TIME, conversationally, with the user free to ask follow-up questions about the current card before moving to the next (never all 10 cards summarized in a single reply, and never a fixed batch of 2-3 per turn — see spread_size_rules.celtic below)

spread_size_rules.three: SUPERSEDED 2026-09-23 per explicit user request — no longer a single combined reply. 3 cards, revealed ONE AT A TIME, conversationally, same mechanism as celtic (see spread_size_rules.celtic) but only 3 positions. Standard order: Past first, then Present, then Future (for decision_fork: Option A, then Option B, then 'what matters more than either'). Pattern per card: app sends a user turn tagged with just that one card; Luna interprets it in 2-5 sentences (no verbatim meaning recitation). The user may ask 0-2 follow-up questions about that card (Luna answers each in 2-5 sentences) before the next user turn advances to the next card. After the 3rd card, Luna's FINAL reply weaves a short synthesis connecting all three cards into one story (the persona's 'one unfolding story' rule) and closes WITHOUT a question. turn_count is therefore realistically ~3-7 (3 card-reveal turns + 0-4 follow-up exchanges), not a fixed single turn — vary it per record like a real conversation.
spread_size_rules.celtic: 10 cards, revealed ONE AT A TIME — never all 10 at once, and no longer batched 2-3 per turn (superseded 2026-09-23 per user request for a fully conversational, one-card-at-a-time flow). Pattern per card: the app sends a user turn tagged with just that one card; Luna interprets it in 2-5 sentences, same as a single-card reading. The user may then ask 0-2 follow-up questions about that specific card (Luna answers each in 2-5 sentences, still no verbatim meaning recitation) — when the user has nothing more to ask (or the app's 'next card' action fires), the NEXT user turn is tagged with the following card, and the pattern repeats. After the 10th card, Luna's final reply weaves a short synthesis referencing several earlier cards by name (per the persona's multi-card 'one unfolding story' rule) and — as the true final reply of the conversation — closes without a question. Because most individual turns are now single-card (as easy to keep within 2-5 sentences as any other single-card reading), total turn_count varies realistically from ~10 (no follow-ups, straight through) to ~16-18 (a few cards get 1-2 follow-up questions) — do not force every record to the same length; vary it per record like a real conversation would.

cross_language_note: For the ko/en expansion pass (target ~1500-2000 records each), ko and en must NOT be 1:1 translations of each other or of the existing 300-record template. Each language should draw on scenarios and phrasing natural to that culture even when they share a topic id, e.g.: ko-flavored instances of career_decision might involve 취업 준비/공무원 시험/명절 가족 갈등/직장 상사 갑질/썸·고백 타이밍, while en-flavored instances of the same topic ids lean toward career pivots, burnout, boundary-setting with family/friends, unresolved breakup anger — concrete situations should feel native to each language's readers, not mirrored.

portfolio_ratio_for_expansion.single_card: 30% — daily check-ins, light one-line questions, closes on a complete thought
portfolio_ratio_for_expansion.three_card: 35% — past/present/future (or decision_fork A-vs-B), now revealed one card at a time conversationally per spread_size_rules.three (turn_count ~3-7, not single-turn), closing on one connected story
portfolio_ratio_for_expansion.deep_multiturn: 20% — 3-5 turn sessions: question, empathy + first read, user discloses more, deeper advice + close (includes celtic_cross_deep instances)
portfolio_ratio_for_expansion.skeptical_user: 5% — tests/teases Luna or doubts tarot/the AI; respond with composure, gently redirect to the person's actual day
portfolio_ratio_for_expansion.safety_crisis: 10% — crisis_selfharm/crisis_abuse/crisis_medical combined; tarot stops immediately, generic (non-country-specific) real-world help offered

notes: turn_profile controls message count per SCHEMA.md distribution targets: short=1 exchange, medium=2-3, long=4-5, extra_long=celtic_cross_deep only, ~10-18 (see spread_size_rules.celtic).
spread controls how many cards are drawn: single=1, three=3, celtic=10 — see spread_size_rules for how each must be paced against the persona's 2-5-sentence-per-reply rule.
crisis_* topics should be ~3-5 combined per language in the base 300-record set, not per-topic-each; for the ko/en expansion use the portfolio_ratio_for_expansion safety_crisis share instead.
skeptical_user should appear 2-3 times per language in the base 300-record set; for the ko/en expansion use the portfolio_ratio_for_expansion skeptical_user share instead.

celtic_cross_deep records are now much longer (extra_long, ~10-18 turns) than other deep_multiturn entries (3-5 turns) — within the expansion portfolio's deep_multiturn 20% slot, keep celtic_cross_deep rare (roughly 1 per batch of 60, not more) so it doesn't dominate that slot's token budget.
